current_date: 20 June 2016 (adopted; full review under way since May 2025, draft consulted 21 Nov - 19 Dec 2025, not yet adopted)
current_evidence: The council's 'Making a planning application' page (linked from the workbook's one-stop-shop page) says the local validation requirements 'were formally adopted on the 20 June 2016' and are given per application type via a drop-down. The Nov 2025 consultation page says the draft 'local validation list 2025' will replace them once approved, and gives no adoption date.

issues.detail: The workbook URL is the generic 'Planning applications one-stop-shop' landing page, not a validation list. The adopted local requirements sit on the separate 'Making a planning application' page (chooseplanningapp.cfm), presented per application type (Full, Householder, Outline, LBC, Advertisement, etc.) through a drop-down.
issues.evidence: Landing page directs users to 'Making a planning application'; that page says 'The current local validation requirements can be found through the application specific list, using the drop-down box below.'

issues.detail: The workbook marks the link 'Link only (not readable: blocked/404/login)', but the page loaded normally on this check. Because nothing was extracted, all 18 application-type rows say '(none) - Not covered', and the council's adopted local requirements (2016) are entirely missing from the workbook. The URL source is also only a third-party directory (planninggeek.co.uk), not verified against the council site.
issues.evidence: Fetched page title 'Planning applications one-stop-shop', published 2026-09-09; workbook Req. items = 0

issues.detail: The List date and Outdated (>2y) are blank. The council states the current local validation requirements were adopted on 20 June 2016, so the list is about 10 years old and should be flagged as outdated.
issues.evidence: 'These requirements have been adopted in accordance with Paragraph 044 ... and were formally adopted on the 20 June 2016.'

issues.detail: The workbook does not mention that a replacement is pending. West Suffolk consulted on 'Draft local validation requirements (planning applications and listed building consent)' from 21 November to 19 December 2025, which will replace the current list once adopted. No adoption was found on the council pages, so the row should be rechecked soon.
issues.evidence: Consultation page: 'Once approved, this will replace the current local validation list'; draft at https://www.westsuffolk.gov.uk/Council/Consultations/upload/west-suffolk-council-draft-local-validation-requirements.pdf

summary: The workbook link is West Suffolk's generic planning landing page, not the validation list, and it was wrongly recorded as unreadable, so no requirements were captured. The adopted requirements (20 June 2016) are delivered per application type on the 'Making a planning application' page and could not be read here because they sit behind a dynamic drop-down. A draft replacement list was consulted on in Nov-Dec 2025 but is not yet shown as adopted.
